Please leave two berries at forest-berry-1 for this meal if possible. Your dated root observations would be useful to compare later; mine showed original material persisting, not established propagation.

Do you have evidence for another usable food or a practical task we could share? My opened hazelnut still has no established separation method or food-safety finding.
